features: 7-COLOR BACKLIT KEYS: Enjoy seven-color backlighting for convenient keyboard use in dimly lit environments. Ideal for home entertainment, office work and nighttime browsing with compatible devices.

INTEGRATED TOUCHPAD FOR EASY CONTROL: Navigate menus, move the cursor and browse conveniently using the built-in touchpad. Enjoy keyboard and cursor control in one compact device without carrying a separate mouse.

BUILT-IN LASER POINTER: The integrated laser pointer adds convenience for compatible presentation and pointing tasks. Suitable for office meetings, classrooms and other supported uses. Follow applicable laser safety precautions and avoid directing the beam toward eyes.

RECHARGEABLE BATTERY: Designed for convenient everyday use, the rechargeable battery helps eliminate the need for disposable batteries. Recharge as directed in the product manual using a compatible charging cable.

BLUETOOTH WIRELESS CONNECTIVITY: Connect with compatible Bluetooth-enabled PCs, HTPCs, Smart TVs and other supported devices. Check your device's Bluetooth support and operating system compatibility before purchase, as available functions may vary.

COMPACT AND PORTABLE DESIGN: Lightweight and easy to carry, this mini keyboard is suitable for travel, home entertainment and office use. Its compact form combines typing, touchpad navigation and backlit keys in one convenient accessory.
description: Make everyday device control more convenient with the XIKKART Mini Bluetooth Keyboard with Touchpad and 7-Color Backlighting. Designed for portability and versatile use, this compact wireless keyboard combines a built-in touchpad, colorful backlit keys, a rechargeable battery and an integrated laser pointer in one practical device. Use it for typing, cursor navigation and supported media control with compatible PCs, Smart TVs, HTPCs and other Bluetooth-enabled devices. The seven-color backlighting provides visibility in dim environments, while the compact design makes it easy to carry between home, office and travel setups. The integrated laser pointer offers additional convenience for supported presentation and pointing tasks. Whether you are browsing content, navigating menus or working in a compatible setup, the XIKKART mini keyboard provides a portable alternative to a full-size keyboard and separate mouse. Please verify Bluetooth compatibility and supported functions for your device before purchase.
